title: NormalizedRelationship v1
description: Canonical normalized relationship (edge) between two entities in the enterprise knowledge graph. Produced by the ingestion pipeline with provenance tracking and confidence scoring.

relationship_type.description: Edge label from the enterprise ontology (e.g. DEPENDS_ON, AUTHORED_BY, IMPLEMENTS).

from_id.description: Canonical ID of the source vertex.

to_id.description: Canonical ID of the target vertex.

evidence_refs.description: References to evidence records supporting this relationship.

confidence.description: Confidence that this relationship correctly represents the real-world connection.

properties.description: Optional edge properties (e.g. weight, timestamp, metadata).
